use: Roman siege works behind the line: a siege tower beyond the board's west edge, where the Romans attack a wall (Chapters IX and XII).

generator.prompt: A Roman siege tower: a tall square timber tower of three storeys on four solid wooden wheels, about seven metres high and three metres square, its front and sides covered with overlapping raw hides against fire, an open fighting platform with a drawbridge hinged at the top storey, and heavy corner posts. Weathered dark timber and brown hides. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
